Type: adjustable swivel counter stool
Use: seating at a counter or bar; kitchen, dining room
Style: industrial, rustic, farmhouse
Materials: solid wood saddle seat, black distressed metal frame, exposed screw mechanism
Colors: medium warm brown wood, black
Shape: backless contoured tractor-style seat, central screw post, four curved splayed legs, round foot ring, compact and open
Feel: rugged, warm, vintage
Goes with: reclaimed wood, concrete, black metal, brick; industrial or farmhouse kitchens

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Industrial Swivel Kitchen Dining Room Counter/Bar Stool, Adjustable 26 Inch-30 Inch Height, Brown Wood
product.description: This barstool is high-style industrial and versatile as well. The seat adjusts from counter height to bar height with a few simple turns. Natural color variations in the wood seat make each one uniquely beautiful. The base is made of durable metal. 17.75" Diameter. Height adusts from 26"-30." Solid wood and metal Adjustable height allows this stool to work with a counter or bar Assemble in 15-30 minutes. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
